text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I am here... to soothe this burning heat 
within me, this craving that aches so 
deeply.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't expect anything from you. ...Just 
don't get in my way, and that's enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
